name: Stormbringer: Studious and Master Elementalist native spell modifiers (#864, #2784)
contract: #864: Studious (705657) effect 0 is aura 108 SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME, BasePoints -16 (raw) = -15%, class mask (2048, 128, 0) matching Shock (dword0 bit11) and Brine (dword1 bit7, Tempest Sovereign's transformed Shock). SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME is applied generically in SpellInfo::CalcCastTime via ApplySpellMod (Unit.cpp:12317), gated only by SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod, which has no exemption for SpellFamilyName 22 (Stormbringer). The rank this scenario learns (804020) has CastingTimeIndex 16 -> SpellCastTimes.dbc id 16 CastTime 1500 ms (the investigation's original 1700 ms/index 90 figure was read off rank 503326, not 804020: every other Shock rank id, including 804020, uses index 5 or 16, never 90), so the -15% reduction lands at 1275 ms. #2784: Master Elementalist (705662) has two aura-107 SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER effects: effect 0 BasePoints 9 (raw) = +10, class mask (2048, 0, 0) matching Shock; effect 1 BasePoints 19 (raw) = +20, class mask (8388608, 0, 0) matching Aeroblast. Its own tooltip reads 'Increases the spell damage scaling of Shock by 10% and Aeroblast by 20%', matching both raw+1 values and both classmask targets exactly. SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER is applied generically in Unit::SpellBonusDamage (Unit.cpp:9358-9360) after the base coefficient is sourced from spell_bonus_data or the native EffectBonusMultiplier, so the modifier itself is proven with Player::ApplySpellMod against an arbitrary base, independent of PR #4612's pending coefficient restoration for Shock/Aeroblast. Neither passive has any module code (zero hits for 705657 or 705662 under modules/ or src/server/), and none is needed; both close as regression scenarios only.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle

DISCRIMINATING: Master Elementalist adds +20 to Aeroblast's bonus-multiplier modifier
